label: fix-batch-7
tail:
Step-3 fix pass done for batch 7. Reviewing Alpha was group `a`; all four `B7-` findings answered.

**B7-1 — applied.** Confirmed the mechanism from disk (`facts-block.mjs` `FACT_LINE_RE`, `proof-contract.mjs:110`) before editing. All 233 citations across the 60 entries relabelled and the 315 `derivations[].inputs` label references renamed with them: `F#` for a published item outside the batch (117), `L#` for an item built inside the pair (116) — batch 5's convention. Numbering restarts per family per entry in existing order; 156 changed, 77 already correct. Verified afterwards: every `fact` matches `^[FAL]\d+$`, no label repeats inside an entry, every label input resolves. `uses` untouched, no mathematics changed.

**B7-2 — applied.** Extended Tao GSM 126 to §§1.6.1–1.6.2 (printed pp. 137–155) and harvested the range: **Exercise 1.6.8 (Steinhaus theorem), p. 140** backs `thm-steinhaus-difference-set-contains-a-ball` (now `literature-derived`), and **Exercise 1.6.25, p. 153** backs `lem-a-set-of-positive-finite-measure-fills-most-of-a-dyadic-cube` — its part (ii) hint is this page's dyadic route and part (iii) reproves Steinhaus from it. 37 rows added (2 included, 2 already-published, 33 deferred to resolving plan-spec pages). For `cor-a-measurable-subgroup-of-rn-of-positive-measure-is-rn` no reachable textbook or lecture-note states it — I fetched and searched Hunter, Carlen, Fremlin ch. 44, Bruckner–Bruckner–Thomson, Princeton MAT425, Heil, Jury and McMullen, and only Fremlin mentions the result at all, in the abstract Haar form. It is backed instead from **Ye–Yu–Zhao `arXiv:2505.00556` §1**, whose Theorem 1.1 is Steinhaus in exactly this page's ℝⁿ ball form and whose Corollary 1.2 is the contrapositive the item's own strategy already cited; recorded as `kind: paper`, explicitly not primary backing. Wikipedia now backs no item. `source-fetch-check --stamp` 5/5, Tao's hash byte-identical to the earlier stamp; `url-sweep --recover --fail-on-dead` 5/5 live.

**B7-3 — seven of eight applied, one pushed back.** Seven rows re-dispositioned to `already-published` naming verified-published items. **Pushed back on Tao Exercise 1.2.4:** `already-published` would be an inaccurate citation. What is published is weaker — `ex-distance-to-a-set-is-attained-on-a-compact-set` gives positive distance for two disjoint *compact* sets, `cex-set-distance-is-not-a-metric` gives two disjoint *closed* sets at distance 0; the compact-plus-closed statement is on no item and `compactness-in-metric-spaces` has none. Nothing here needs it (the page uses Heine–Borel directly), and adding a metric-topology item to a measure page would be a silent seam, so the row is `deferred` to `owner-decision`.

**B7-4 — applied.** Title now opens "Assuming countable choice, …", `def-countable-choice` added to `deps` as its two neighbours have, strategy states the hypothesis is inherited from the Littlewood theorem, and §8's choice bullet names the item so step 5 cannot drop it again.

Gates re-run: `coverage-checklist` 166 rows / 0 errors, `content-policy --manifest-only` over all batch manifests 796 items / 0 errors, `validate-plan` OK (only the pre-existing `redundant-prereq` advisories Alpha also saw). `prosecheck` on the notes: 0 errors, 23 warnings, all pre-existing report-style counts. `proof-contract` cannot run yet — it returns `item-missing` ×60 and nothing else, because no item is authored until step 5; the label verification above is what was runnable. Page unchanged at 55 A items and 13 B items — B7-2 added sources, not items.
